style: Plushbound-original coastal JRPG art with MV/Trinity-inspired functional readability; no proprietary RPG Maker artwork.

identity.theme: A bright maritime coast of sea-glass harbors, wind-polished cliffs, tidal gardens, stitched sails and ancient flooded Waystitches.
identity.fashion: Chinese/Japanese/Victorian silhouettes adapted for humid ports, sailing, fishing, diving and formal merchant culture.
identity.silhouetteRule: Harbor, cliff, island, reef, storm and submerged spaces must remain recognizable without relying only on palette swaps.

subregions.visual: tiered saltwood docks, sea-glass roofs, merchant halls, ferries, cranes and lantern piers
shallow turquoise water, drying nets, stitched sails, tidal gardens and family workshops
high grass, rope bridges, gull roosts, windmills, signal towers and sheer ocean drops
small beaches, coral shelves, mangroves, shell shrines and boat landings
black surf, shattered sea-glass, lightning rods, wreckage and flooded caves
bioluminescent pools, shell mosaics, kelp curtains, submerged passages and tide mechanisms
partially submerged towers, broken thread-machinery, flooded halls and Fraying distortions
calm moonlit lagoon, pale reefs, floating lantern buoys and intact ancient Waystitch structures

populationArt.childPolicy: Children use age-appropriate proportions, clothing, activities and dialogue-supporting expressions; no adult occupational or combat styling.

characterCreator.rule: Clothing remains cosmetic-first and compatible with appearance overrides rather than forcing combat stats.

guardians.rule: Guardians are inhabitants and companions, not hostile loot creatures; their silhouettes must remain distinct from monsters and readable at mobile scale.

enemiesBosses.rule: Marine enemies use readable fantasy silhouettes and do not visually collapse into Plush Guardian designs.

itemsEquipment.guardianMaterialRule: Guardian-associated crafting materials come from gifts, grooming, bonding, shed fibers or habitat finds rather than harming Guardians.

effectsUi.accessibility: Interactive water, hazards and boss telegraphs must remain identifiable without color alone.

definitionOfComplete: Every planned asset has a stable logical ID before implementation binding.
Art dimensions and transparency policy match engine import requirements.
All eight subregions possess unique environment, NPC, encounter and audio identities.
Two-times reserve is meaningful variation rather than duplicate recolors.
Visual QA checks normal anatomy, readable silhouettes, clean transparency and mobile-scale readability.
Generated files are not marked ready until the actual asset exists and passes QA.
No gameplay/runtime implementation is required during this asset-first phase.
